entities.summary: Marie Juliette Boulanger, professionally known as Lili Boulanger, was a French composer and musician, associated with the Symbolist and Impressionist movements. The first woman to win the Grand Prix de Rome composition competition, her older sister was the composer and composition teacher Nadia Boulanger; their father was the composer Ernest Boulanger. Lili Boulanger was a composers & musicians from Paris (1893-08-21, Paris–1918-03-15). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
